{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2022–23 |team=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos |image=UC Santa Barbara Gauchos wordmark.svg |image_size=200 |conference=Big West Conference |division= |short_conf=Big West |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=27–8 |conf_record=15–5 |head_coach=[[Joe Pasternack]] |hc_year=6th |asst_coach1=Larry Lewis |asst_coach2=Ben Tucker |asst_coach3=Derek Glasser |stadium=[[UC Santa Barbara Events Center|The Thunderdome]]
(Capacity: 5,000) |champion=[[Big West Conference|Big West]] co-regular season and [[2023 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|tournament]] champions | tourney = [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] | tourney_result = First Round }} {{2022–23 Big West men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]] in the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gauchos, led by sixth-year head coach [[Joe Pasternack]], played their home games at [[UC Santa Barbara Events Center|The Thunderdome]] in [[Santa Barbara, California]] as members of the [[Big West Conference]]. They finished the season 27–7, 15–5 in Big West Play to tie as regular season champions. They defeated [[2022–23 Cal Poly Mustangs men's basketball team|Cal Poly]], [[2022–23 UC Riverside Highlanders men's basketball team|UC Riverside]], and [[2022–23 Cal State Fullerton Titans men's basketball team|Cal State Fullerton]] to be champions of the [[2023 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]]. They received the Big West’s automatic bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2022–23 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team|Gauchos]] finished the 2021–22 season 17–11, 8–5 in Big West play to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2021–22 UC Irvine Anteaters men's basketball team|UC Irvine]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Big West Conference men's basketball tournament|Big West tournament]] before losing to
